question: _______ is the money that is available from an individual's salary after he/she pays local, state, and federal taxes.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Disposable Income**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Disposable Income** is the money that is available from an individual's salary after he/she pays local, state, and federal taxes.
 
• It is the amount of net income a household or individual has available to invest, save, or spend after income taxes have been deducted.
 
• Disposable income is crucial for determining the standard of living and the economic health of individuals or households.
 
• It is used by economists to measure the financial health and capacity of consumers to spend and save.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Personal Income** refers to the total earnings received by an individual, including wages, salaries, bonuses, and other forms of income before taxes.
 
• **Per Capita Income** is the average income earned per person in a given area in a specified year.
 
• **National Income** is the total value of all goods and services produced by a country over a specific period, usually a year.
 
• Understanding disposable income is important for financial planning, budgeting, and economic analysis.
